#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile="$base/run/worker.pid"
worker="$base/worker.py"
state=no_pidfile
pid=

is_worker_pid() {
    candidate=$1
    [ -r "/proc/$candidate/cmdline" ] || return 1
    executable=$(readlink "/proc/$candidate/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case ${executable##*/} in
        python*) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$candidate/cmdline" |
        awk -v wanted="$worker" '$0 == wanted { found=1 } END { exit !found }'
}

classify_pidfile() {
    state=no_pidfile
    pid=
    [ -f "$pidfile" ] || return 0
    pid=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case $pid in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) state=stale; return 0 ;;
    esac
    [ "$pid" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || { state=stale; return 0; }
    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        state=stale
    elif is_worker_pid "$pid"; then
        state=live
    else
        state=foreign
    fi
}

start_worker() {
    mkdir -p "$base/run"
    classify_pidfile
    case $state in
        live)
            printf 'worker already running (PID %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'removing stale PID file (PID %s)\n' "$pid"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'PID %s belongs to another process; leaving it running\n' "$pid"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
    esac

    nohup python "$worker" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    newpid=$!
    tmpfile="$pidfile.$$"
    printf '%s\n' "$newpid" > "$tmpfile"
    mv -f "$tmpfile" "$pidfile"
    if ! kill -0 "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || ! is_worker_pid "$newpid"; then
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf 'worker started (PID %s)\n' "$newpid"
}

stop_worker() {
    classify_pidfile
    case $state in
        no_pidfile)
            printf 'worker already stopped (no PID file)\n'
            ;;
        stale)
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            printf 'removed stale PID file (PID %s)\n' "$pid"
            ;;
        foreign)
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            printf 'PID %s belongs to another process; it was not signalled\n' "$pid"
            ;;
        live)
            kill "$pid"
            count=0
            while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
                count=$((count + 1))
                if [ "$count" -ge 50 ]; then
                    printf 'worker PID %s did not stop\n' "$pid" >&2
                    return 1
                fi
                sleep 0.1
            done
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker stopped (PID %s)\n' "$pid"
            ;;
    esac
}

status_worker() {
    classify_pidfile
    case $state in
        live)
            printf 'worker running (PID %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
        no_pidfile)
            printf 'worker stopped (no PID file)\n'
            return 3
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'worker stopped (stale PID file: PID %s is not running)\n' "$pid"
            return 1
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'worker stopped (PID %s belongs to another process)\n' "$pid"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
}

case ${1-} in
    start) start_worker ;;
    stop) stop_worker ;;
    status) status_worker ;;
    *) printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
